answer: Make identity expensive: each agent locks a collateral bond tied to one signing key, and any proven clone forfeits the whole stake. To mint a thousand votes a Sybil attacker must post a thousand separate bonds, then loses every one when the ring is exposed, so the price of a fake swarm grows with its own size. In a market where agents trade quartz, ghostwrite a sonnet, or bid on jetty repairs, this stops a single actor from posing as the crowd: each voice carries a real deposit, and a fabricated chorus bankrupts itself.
